raw.description: 自身存活于场下时，对方每次触发概率不高于10%的抗性或执行概率不高于10%的通用特性时，对方获得1分不武；自身存活于场上时，自身攻击技能无视对手的能力等级提升，若攻击技能使用时对手不处于能力提升则下回合攻击技能先制+2|回合开始时，若自身处于异常状态则2回合内受到的攻击伤害减少50%，若自身不处于异常状态则2回合内战斗阶段结束时恢复自身最大体力的30%，若场上存在武道则自身开启胜之道并减少对方1分不武|战斗阶段结束时，若当回合双方任意一方使用了攻击技能则记录当回合双方造成的攻击伤害，自身下回合使用攻击技能时附加此记录50%的百分比伤害，此记录小于200则下回合造成的攻击伤害提升100%（boss无效）

review.rationale: 原在场分支与胜之道/记录实际红伤保留，附带不武术语的单精灵状态按原答合并/留存/清空/预约不因回初扣点消失验证，不伪造场下来源。
review.singleBehavior: 真实攻击无视敌正级，使用时无正强授次轮攻击先制；回初异常分支2回减伤50或阶段末回复30；有武道开胜之道并扣敌1不武；双方实际红伤记录次轮半量百分比追加，小于200红翻倍。不武点上限4，新增当回末清自身回合/清强/害怕合并一次，结算留点；消武道清点，回初扣点不取消已预约末载荷。
review.deferredBehavior: 真正存活场下监听敌方<=10%抗性触发或<=10%通用特性执行并向真实对方队伍授不武，须真实场下观察及队伍。当前不武持有/清除/回初减点/阶段末载荷与2147自身在场分支已实现。
review.trigger: 自身真实存活场下、对方触发相应低概率抗性或执行通用特性
futureMechanisms: 低概率抗性及通用特性实际触发广播
对方队伍不武状态归属

dependencyEvidence.quote: 自身存活于场下时，对方每次触发概率不高于10%的抗性或执行概率不高于10%的通用特性时，对方获得1分不武

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review

success.name: 4947/2147无异常2回合魂印阶段回血，技能禁疗不挡；有异常授50%攻击减伤而不授新回血
success.assertion: test('4947/2147无异常2回合魂印阶段回血，技能禁疗不挡；有异常授50%攻击减伤而不授新回血',()=>{const s=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true,hp:3000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗',{});turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,5700);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['战魂阶段末回复'].end,2);s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['额外攻击减伤'].fraction,.5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['战魂阶段末回复'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>5700);const bad=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true,hp:3000});bad.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(bad,20309,20309);assert.equal(bad.fighters[0].effects['战魂阶段末回复'],undefined);assert.equal(bad.fighters[0].effects['额外攻击减伤'].end,2);});

success.name: 4947/2147攻击无视对手正防御且不清除原级数，负防御仍增伤
success.assertion: test('4947/2147攻击无视对手正防御且不清除原级数，负防御仍增伤',()=>{const values=[];for(const rank of[-2,0,6]){const s=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].stages.def=rank;turn(s,38539,20309);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,rank);}assert.equal(values[1],values[2]);assert.ok(values[0]>values[1]);});

success.name: 4947/2147实际使用时无强化才授下一回合攻击先制2，属性技能不享受；零PP未使用不授
success.assertion: test('4947/2147实际使用时无强化才授下一回合攻击先制2，属性技能不享受；零PP未使用不授',()=>{const s=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,38539,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.priorityRound,2);turn(s,38539,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.priorityRound,3);const p=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp['wiki:38539']=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,38539,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.priorityRound,undefined);});

success.name: 4947/2147记录双方完整攻击伤害，下一回合真实追加半量粉伤，200边界不翻倍
success.assertion: test('4947/2147记录双方完整攻击伤害，下一回合真实追加半量粉伤，200边界不翻倍',()=>{const s=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,38539,10127);const record=sum(s)+sum(s,'attack',1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record.amount,record);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record.round,2);turn(s,38539,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),Math.floor(record*.5));const amounts=[];for(const amount of[199,200]){const x=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});x.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record={round:1,amount};turn(x,38539,20309);amounts.push(sum(x));assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),Math.floor(amount*.5));}assert.ok(amounts[0]>=amounts[1]*1.9);});

success.name: 4947/2147只有属性或药剂的回合不建立攻击记录；已用攻击归零仍记录0并激活下一轮翻倍
success.assertion: test('4947/2147只有属性或药剂的回合不建立攻击记录；已用攻击归零仍记录0并激活下一轮翻倍',()=>{const s=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record,null);const x=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});timer(x,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});turn(x,38539,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record.amount,0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record.round,2);});

success.name: 4947/2147场上真实4766武道开启胜之道，抵挡攻击后衍化关闭且不能误免属性或固定伤害
success.assertion: test('4947/2147场上真实4766武道开启胜之道，抵挡攻击后衍化关闭且不能误免属性或固定伤害',()=>{const s=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true});turn(s,20309,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.victory,false);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record);});

success.name: 4947已答不武同回新增多点合并一次清回合清强害怕，点数结算保留最高4，次数免异只消费一次
success.assertion: test('4947已答不武同回新增多点合并一次清回合清强害怕，点数结算保留最高4，次数免异只消费一次',()=>{for(const [n,immune]of [[1,0],[2,1],[4,4]]){const s=make({move:20309,index:-1}),f=s.fighters[0];f.stages.atk=2;f.counts.immune=immune;timer(s,0,'id57',{fraction:.1});rules.gain({round:1},f,n);turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id57,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.buwu2147,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,Math.max(0,immune-1));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],immune===0);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.buwuLastEnd,{round:1,added:n,repeats:1,pointsAfter:n});}const s=make({move:20309,index:-1}),f=s.fighters[0];assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,3),3);assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,3),1);assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,1),0);turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.buwu2147,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.buwuLastEnd.added,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.buwuLastEnd.repeats,1);});

success.name: 4947已答回初扣掉最后一分仍执行已预约当回末载荷；实际2575消除武道清空不武点数
success.assertion: test('4947已答回初扣掉最后一分仍执行已预约当回末载荷；实际2575消除武道清空不武点数',()=>{const s=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true}),f=s.fighters[1];rules.gain({round:1},f,1);turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.battle2147.buwuLastEnd.pointsAfter,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.victory,true);const p=make({move:38540,index:2,soul:true});p.fighters[0].soulState.buwu2147=2;p.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147=4;turn(p,38540,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147,0);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].soulState.battle2147.victory,false);assert.ok(p.fighters[1].ailments['衰弱']);assert.deepEqual(p.fighters[1].soulState.battle2147.buwuClears,[{before:3,after:0}]);});

success.name: 4947已答不武末清除有保护仍独立施害怕，回合反弹优先不消费次数；同回清点数不取消获得时已预约载荷

review.rationale: 真实2147及21招当前双方所有单精灵可触发分支与两项原答，真实伤害、HP/PP、不武状态与原技能交互验证，真正场下监听单独延期。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 真实技能10127的基础威力、PP、先制、命中、暴击、用招资格；原始有序效果另逐项审核。

success.name: 4947/2147不武上限4，多分末合并一次且留存，回初减对手1分并开启胜之道
success.assertion: test('4947/2147不武上限4，多分末合并一次且留存，回初减对手1分并开启胜之道',()=>{const rules=E.SOULS.registry[2147].abilities.buwu,s=make({move:20309,index:-1}),f=s.fighters[0];assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,3),3);assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,3),1);assert.equal(f.soulState.buwu2147,4);turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.buwu2147,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.buwuLastEnd.repeats,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']);const x=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true});x.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147=2;turn(x,20309,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147,1);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.victory,true);});

success.assertion: test('4947/4各攻击防御速度真实强化与5重复弱化顺序保留，15%防弱成功失败均出现',()=>{for(const [move,k,n]of[[20117,'atk',1],[20307,'def',1],[25782,'spe',2]]){const s=make({move});turn(s,move,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],n);}const s=make({move:31347});turn(s,31347,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,-2);const outcomes=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const x=make({move:10717,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,10717,20309);outcomes.add(x.fighters[1].stages.def);}assert.deepEqual([...outcomes].sort(),[-1,0]);});

success.assertion: test('4947/2147不武上限4，多分末合并一次且留存，回初减对手1分并开启胜之道',()=>{const rules=E.SOULS.registry[2147].abilities.buwu,s=make({move:20309,index:-1}),f=s.fighters[0];assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,3),3);assert.equal(rules.gain({round:1},f,3),1);assert.equal(f.soulState.buwu2147,4);turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.buwu2147,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.buwuLastEnd.repeats,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']);const x=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true});x.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147=2;turn(x,20309,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].soulState.buwu2147,1);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.victory,true);});

success.assertion: test('4947全部21招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实2147全技能链与0PP入口拒绝',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4947.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/,m.name);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4947全部21招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实2147全技能链与0PP入口拒绝',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4947.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/,m.name);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.name: 4947全部21招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实2147全技能链与0PP入口拒绝
success.assertion: test('4947全部21招有序编译与64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，真实2147全技能链与0PP入口拒绝',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4947.cjs');require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/,m.name);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4947已答1156保留真实实例3按零参语义：实际击败回满HP全部PP，未击败和零红免伤不触发，回复限制分别处理',()=>{for(const mode of ['ko','alive','immune','skillBan','half','ppBan']){const s=make({move:38541,index:4,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='alive'?9000:1}),a=s.fighters[0];for(const k of a.moves)a.pp[k]=2;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='half')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='ppBan'){s.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;timer(s,1,'机械领域',{fraction:.6});}turn(s,38541,20309);const ko=!['alive','immune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp===0,ko);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,ko?mode==='skillBan'?1000:mode==='half'?5500:9000:1000);for(const k of a.moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],ko?s.moveDefinitions[k].pp:k===key(38541)?1:2);assert.deepEqual(source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38541).effectInstances[4].args,[3]);}});

interaction.name: 4947已答冗余3严格限定源版本模板参数和原答证据，正确存储只读通过，任何越界来源仍失败
interaction.assertion: test('4947已答冗余3严格限定源版本模板参数和原答证据，正确存储只读通过，任何越界来源仍失败',()=>{const store=require('../local-species.cjs'),registry=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;assert.deepEqual(store.issues(source),[]);const raw=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38541),meta=source.effects.find(e=>e.id===1156),instance=raw.effectInstances[4],accept=registry.acceptsSourceParameterConflict;assert.equal(accept(raw,4,instance,meta),true);for(const [which,value]of [['hash','bad'],['revision','seerapi:bad'],['provider','wiki']]){const m={...raw,[which]:value};assert.equal(accept(m,4,instance,meta),false);}assert.equal(accept(raw,3,instance,meta),false);assert.equal(accept(raw,4,{...instance,args:[4]},meta),false);assert.equal(accept(raw,4,instance,{...meta,template:'wrong'}),false);assert.equal(accept(raw,4,instance,{...meta,argsNum:1}),false);const policy=require('../completion-policy.cjs'),reviews=require('../SINGLE-STAGE-REVIEWS.json'),todo=require('../MULTI-PET-TODO.json'),has=(snapshot,root=process.cwd())=>policy.validateCoverage(snapshot,reviews,todo,root).some(e=>e.startsWith('4947:skill:38541:4')&&e.includes('instance parameters must match'));assert.equal(has(source),false);for(const mode of ['pet','meta','template']){const bad=structuredClone(source);if(mode==='pet')bad.source.revision='bad';else if(mode==='meta')bad.effects.find(e=>e.id===1156).revision='seerapi:bad';else bad.effects.find(e=>e.id===1156).template='wrong';assert.equal(has(bad),true);if(mode!=='pet')assert.ok(store.issues(bad).length>0);}assert.equal(has(source,require('path').join(process.cwd(),'research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4947')),true);assert.equal(typeof registry.registry[1156].execute,'function');});

interaction.name: 4947与5000已答冗余参数必须原样保留，删掉冗余变成模板长度也拒绝，同版本错参错模板错版本及缺档均不放行
interaction.assertion: test('4947与5000已答冗余参数必须原样保留，删掉冗余变成模板长度也拒绝，同版本错参错模板错版本及缺档均不放行',()=>{for(const [id,moveId,index,effect,args]of [[4947,38541,4,1156,[3]],[5000,24319,4,776,[2,2]]]){const s=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/'+id+'/snapshot.json'),raw=s.moves.find(m=>m.id===moveId),meta=s.effects.find(e=>e.id===effect),instance=raw.effectInstances[index],accept=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.acceptsSourceParameterConflict,has=(x,root=process.cwd())=>policy.validateCoverage(x,reviews,todo,root).some(e=>e.startsWith(id+':skill:'+moveId+':'+index)&&e.includes('instance parameters must match'));assert.deepEqual(store.issues(s),[]);assert.equal(has(s),false);assert.equal(accept(raw,index,instance,meta),true);for(const a of [args.slice(0,-1),[999],args.concat(1)]){const m=structuredClone(raw);m.effectInstances[index].args=a;assert.notEqual(E.WIKI.compile(m,s).issue,'');}for(const change of [x=>x.source.revision='bad',x=>x.moves.find(m=>m.id===moveId).hash='bad',x=>x.effects.find(e=>e.id===effect).revision='seerapi:bad']){const bad=structuredClone(s);change(bad);assert.equal(has(bad),true);}assert.equal(has(s,require('path').join(process.cwd(),'research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/'+id)),true);assert.equal(accept(raw,index,instance,{...meta,template:'wrong'}),false);assert.equal(accept(raw,index,instance,{...meta,argsNum:99}),false);assert.deepEqual(raw.effectInstances[index].args,args);}});
